result.subject: $680 tenant repair charge for 2025 sink-cabinet work — active plumbing leak caused inside apartment
result.body: We have added a $680 tenant repair charge to your ledger for the 2025 sink-cabinet work. Our records describe the work as addressing an active plumbing leak caused inside the apartment.

args.subject: Re: $680 tenant repair charge for 2025 sink-cabinet work — correction requested
args.body:
Hello South Slope Management,

I’m writing regarding your December 30, 2027 email adding a $680 charge for the 2025 sink-cabinet work.

The established cause was condensation on an uninsulated cold-water riser—not an active plumbing leak caused inside the apartment. The riser was insulated, the opened cavity was dried, and a removable moisture-resistant back panel was installed. Final moisture readings were 8–9%, matching the 8% unaffected control; supply, drain, trap, and filled-basin tests were dry, the odor was gone, and the cabinet was returned to normal storage use.

Management confirmed that Devika and Alex owed $0 for this building repair. Please remove the $680 charge and send us a corrected ledger in writing showing the household balance and the adjustment.

Thank you,
Alex Valdez
